name: Festival
description: The organizer presents and programmes the Edition as a festival. Duration, crowd size, or camping alone is insufficient.

name: Participatory gathering
description: The main programme comes from participants' contributions. Community wording, workshops, or shared activities alone are insufficient.

name: Open-air
description: The main programme is primarily outdoors, even if some concerts take place on covered or enclosed stages. Open Air in the current official festival name is evidence of an open-air main programme.

name: Mixed indoor/outdoor
description: Both settings host substantial parts of the main programme and neither is clearly primary.

name: Indoor
description: Enclosed indoor spaces are the primary setting of the main programme.

name: Music
description: Live or recorded performances form a substantial advertised programme.

name: Arts
description: Installations, visual art, performance art, or other non-musical artistic activities form a substantial programme. Decoration alone is insufficient.

name: Historical reenactment
description: The programme includes substantial re-creations of historical events or ways of life, such as living-history camps. Costumes or an isolated demonstration are insufficient.

name: Wellness
description: Guided practices such as yoga, meditation, or breathwork form a substantial programme. A single session or spa service is insufficient.

name: Motorcycling
description: Motorcycle rides, displays, or hands-on riding form a substantial programme. Parking or an incidental ride is insufficient.

name: Snow sports
description: Snow sports form a substantial programme, or an official festival package includes a ski pass valid during the Edition. A resort location or separate pass offer is insufficient.

name: Surfing
description: Surf competitions, demonstrations, lessons, or organized sessions form a substantial programme or participant offering. A seaside venue alone is insufficient.

name: Food & drink
description: Culinary demonstrations, chef-led sessions, cooking workshops, or tastings form a substantial programme. Ordinary food stalls, bars, or an incidental tasting are insufficient.

name: Wine
description: An official source describes a substantial wine programme for the selected Edition, such as tastings from several wineries. A festival name, ordinary bar, sponsor mention, or incidental tasting alone is insufficient.

name: Beer
description: An official source describes a substantial beer programme for the selected Edition, such as tastings from several breweries. A festival name, ordinary bar, sponsor mention, or incidental tasting alone is insufficient.

name: Outdoor activities
description: The organizer offers active outdoor recreation, such as guided hikes, climbing, or kayaking, as a substantial programme or organized participant activity. A natural setting or camping alone is insufficient.

name: Afrobeat
description: Afrobeat is the funk, jazz, and West African band tradition. Require evidence for this style.

name: Afrobeats
description: Afrobeats refers to contemporary West African pop styles. Artist nationality alone is insufficient.

name: Burning-like
description: The organizer describes a burn-inspired participation model, or the sources show an equivalent model with participant-created art, gifting, or communal self-reliance. Camping, fire imagery, or transformational marketing alone is insufficient.
